protocol_notes.policy_family: Fixed v8 same-family unstacked multi-worker policies (W=8, K<=8, risk lanes, Beta-Binomial adaptive retry, 1-step blame, strict exact-tree commit authority, zero commit-time oracle, zero escaped defects).
protocol_notes.decoupled_priors: Fixed generic scheduler priors (q0=0.10, p_c=0.10, p_persist=0.02, Beta(1,19) flake prior) held completely invariant across all CI-duration and persistent-conflict sensitivity levels.
protocol_notes.ci_duration_motivation_and_distinction: Sweeps mean CI job duration ci_duration_min in {12.0 (default), 16.0, 20.0} min with fixed ci_duration_std=2.0 min. The 16.0 and 20.0 min levels bracket observed TypeScript merge_group GitHub Actions workflow-run execution times (n=45 selected runs: P50=16.0 min, mean=16.1 min, P95=18.8 min). These workflow execution times are explicitly distinct from observed GraphQL merge-queue episode sojourn times (enqueue to removal, which include queueing wait and serialization: TypeScript P50=17.1 min, P95=21.3 min, n=44; Cargo P50=34.2 min, mean=33.5 min, P95=39.2 min, n=56). Simulation sensitivity therefore does NOT calibrate to Cargo sojourn as a CI job duration.
protocol_notes.persistent_conflict_mechanism_and_caveat: Sweeps persistent_conflict_share in {0.03 (v7/v8 default), 0.10, 0.25 (SimConfig dataclass default)} while holding ci_duration_min=12.0, semantic_conflict_prob=0.18, graph_recall=0.80, risk_correlation=1.0, unary defects, total sampled conflict pairs, and decoupled scheduler priors fixed per (repo, seed). Because GroundTruth samples persistent pairs via deterministic hash thresholds over the fixed conflict set, persistent pairs form a strict monotone superset across 0.03 -> 0.10 -> 0.25. Higher persistence causes more PRs to fail persistently against merged_mainline and be rejected, shrinking the merged survivor set over which P95 latency is computed; survivor P95 must therefore be interpreted jointly with accepted PRs and persistent-conflict rejections.
protocol_notes.uncertainty_protocol: 20 paired seeds (1001..1020) x 3 repositories = 60 paired blocks per condition; 10,000 paired seed-block bootstrap resamples (Random(11629)) with equal repository weight plus exact two-sided sign test.
